overview_description.description: Rology is addressing the shortage issue by providing a platform that remotely and quickly matches radiologists with patients from hospitals based on availability and specialism. and boost radiologists' productivity with an AI-powered DICOM reader. As technology progresses, the use of radiology examinations such as CT and MRI has increased globally. While the number of studies expanded rapidly, the number of radiologists increased at a far slower rate, resulting in a severe and acute radiology shortage worldwide.

about_short_description.short_description: Rology is an AI-assisted On-demand Teleradiology Platform.

product.name: AI-Assisted Teleradiology Platform
product.description: An AI-assisted platform that matches medical imaging scans with qualified radiologists for diagnosis and reporting.

product.name: Automated Image and Data Sharing
product.description: Automatically shares medical images and patient history with radiologists for diagnostic purposes.

product.name: Subspecialty Matching
product.description: Matches each medical imaging case with a radiologist specialized in the relevant subspecialty for accurate diagnosis.

product.name: Automated Report and Image Delivery
product.description: Automatically delivers diagnostic reports and images to the submitting hospital or medical institution.

product.name: Emergency Case Priority
product.description: Gives priority to emergency medical cases, committing to deliver reports in less than 90 minutes.

product.name: Zero Setup Cost
product.description: Offers services with no initial setup cost for healthcare facilities.
